bioconda.name: fiji-omero_ij
bioconda.summary: ImageJ / Fiji plugin to visualize and manipulate both image data and metadata maintained at an OMERO server site.
bioconda.description: The OMERO.insight Project is a sub-project of the Open Microscopy Environment Project, OME that focuses on delivering a client for the visualization and manipulation of both image data and metadata maintained at an OMERO server site.
